voice.speaker: firstad
voice.caption: Book nine. The Cyclops's cave. Escape beneath the rams. Take one.

voice.speaker: firstad
voice.caption: Why is the camera in the ram?

voice.speaker: cinematographer
voice.caption: The ram was the hottest thing in the scene. I go where the heat is.

voice.speaker: firstad
voice.caption: He means: get out of the sheep.

voice.speaker: cinematographer
voice.caption: New rule. No lens inside an animal.

voice.speaker: cinematographer
voice.caption: Odysseus, six men, three rams, a ship and a giant.

voice.speaker: director
voice.caption: I'll take your word for it.

voice.speaker: cinematographer
voice.caption: New rule. A frame that is nearly black is refused.

voice.speaker: firstad
voice.caption: He wants to be shot from below.

voice.speaker: cinematographer
voice.caption: From above, the eye was never where his head was.

voice.speaker: director
voice.caption: Half your face is in shadow.

voice.speaker: firstad
voice.caption: The stone. He seals the cave. Take one.

voice.speaker: cinematographer
voice.caption: It was beside the door. Now it is in the door.

voice.speaker: firstad
voice.caption: Take two. This time he carries it.

voice.speaker: firstad
voice.caption: The milking. We lit it again.
